metadata.title: Design and fabrication of vibration based energy harvester using microelectromechanical system piezoelectric cantilever for low power applications.

configuration.quote: We fabricated dual-beam cantilevers on the microelectromechanical system (MEMS) scale with an integrated Si proof mass.
configuration.section: Design and Fabrication of Vibration Based Energy Harvester Using Microelectromechanical System Piezoelectric Cantilever for Low Power Applications

proof_mass.quote: We fabricated dual-beam cantilevers on the microelectromechanical system (MEMS) scale with an integrated Si proof mass.
proof_mass.section: Design and Fabrication of Vibration Based Energy Harvester Using Microelectromechanical System Piezoelectric Cantilever for Low Power Applications

length_mm.quote: The fabricated device has a beam length of about 5400 + 200 um.

width_mm.quote: The each beam width of dual beam cantilever was 290 um.

substrate_thickness_um.quote: The thicknesses of the first silicon layer, the thermal silicon dioxide layer, and the second silicon layer were 10 um, 100 nm, and 500 um, respectively.

piezo_thickness_um.quote: The PZT was coated using the sol–gel method until it reached a thickness of 1.2 um.

type.quote: A PZT cantilever was designed as a mechanical vibration energy-harvesting system for low power applications.
type.section: Design and Fabrication of Vibration Based Energy Harvester Using Microelectromechanical System Piezoelectric Cantilever for Low Power Applications

frequency_Hz.quote: Experiments revealed the resonant frequency, voltage, and average power density to be 78.7 Hz, 118.5 mV, and 0.34 uW, respectively.
frequency_Hz.section: Design and Fabrication of Vibration Based Energy Harvester Using Microelectromechanical System Piezoelectric Cantilever for Low Power Applications

acceleration_g.quote: We obtained a maximum average power of about 0.803 uW at 1.0 g and optimal resistance

motion_source.quote: The cantilever device was mounted on a vibrator.

resonant_frequency_Hz.quote: Experiments revealed the resonant frequency, voltage, and average power density to be 78.7 Hz, 118.5 mV, and 0.34 uW, respectively.
resonant_frequency_Hz.section: Design and Fabrication of Vibration Based Energy Harvester Using Microelectromechanical System Piezoelectric Cantilever for Low Power Applications

output_power_W.quote: We obtained a maximum average power of about 0.803 uW at 1.0 g and optimal resistance
